tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazdy z ponizszych dialogow (1.1-1.6), wybierajac odpowiedz A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Do you fancy going bowling on Saturday?
Y: _________
options: A) I'd love to, but I'm away that weekend.
B) Yes, I went there last Saturday.
C) Sorry, I can't. I'm really looking forward to it.

items.stem:
X: How about meeting outside the cinema at seven?
Y: _________
options: A) Yes, I met him outside the cinema at seven.
B) Seven works for me. See you there.
C) Never mind, it doesn't matter.

items.stem:
X: I can't make it on Friday after all. Something's come up.
Y: _________
options: B) Yes, please come up on Friday.
C) No worries. Shall we say Sunday instead?

items.stem:
X: Shall I book the tickets, or will you do it?
Y: _________
options: A) You go ahead - you know which seats are best.
B) Yes, they were very good seats.
C) I've already booked my summer holiday.

items.stem:
X: We're meeting at my place first, then heading into town.
Y: _________
options: A) Great. What time should I turn on?
B) Great. What time should I turn up?
C) Great. What time should I turn over?

items.stem:
X: Sorry, I completely forgot we'd arranged to meet.
Y: _________
options: A) Thanks a lot, that's very kind of you.
B) Not at all. I'd love to come.
C) Don't worry about it. It happens to everyone.
